| description = 

There are several mobs named an undead knight. This page describes the one that spawns in [[Mistmoore Castle]].

Spawns downstairs in from the prison room. Conned dark blue to my 47 Mage. Did not respond to hails.

Conned green to my 59 Necro. A 500pt nuke did a perfect 25% of his health, likely making him level 40. 3/1/2026.

He seems to be on [[Temple of Solusek Ro]] faction.

For the version in [[Butcherblock Mountains]], see [[an undead knight (Butcherblock)]].

For the version in [[Qeynos Aqueducts]], see [[an undead knight (Qeynos Aqueducts)]].
